clueBoards.title: The practice board
clueBoards.intro: A corkboard in the square, with pins and two balls of yarn. Before a Showdown, anyone may practise here. Red yarn ties a card to Corvan's claim to challenge it. Gold yarn ties a card to a claim you might make, to support it. A claim with no taut yarn glows gold: nothing holds it up yet.

missions.title: The practice board
missions.knowledgeQuestion: How much can one piece of evidence carry?

objectives.title: Optional: on the practice board (west of the square), crack every link of Corvan's claim and hold one claim of yours with two taut yarns.

hints.text: Corvan's claim has three links. Each needs a card that touches that link.
A yarn sags when the claim says more than the card can show. Try the narrower claim.
Your test billet cracks the pattern link. The ledger cracks 'ancient'. The note on two kinds of 'Damascus' cracks the name.
Tie the workshop sheet and the guild ledger to 'This blade is pattern-welded, made in Hesper Lyle's workshop this season.'

journal.text: The practice board: one card can crack one link of a claim. A claim of my own needs cards that carry all of it; if it says more than the cards show, the yarn sags.
My photo album: a caption can say what the picture shows, or what I think about it. Only the first kind can be checked by looking.
